items.q: A 12 V battery is connected across a 4 Ω resistor. What is the current?
items.qAf: ’n 12 V-battery is oor ’n 4 Ω-weerstand gekoppel. Wat is die stroom?

items.q: A current of 2 A flows through a 6 Ω resistor. What is the voltage across it?
items.qAf: ’n Stroom van 2 A vloei deur ’n 6 Ω-weerstand. Wat is die spanning oor dit?

items.q: If the resistance doubles while the voltage stays constant, the current:
items.qAf: As die weerstand verdubbel terwyl die spanning konstant bly, dan die stroom:
items.explain: I = V ÷ R, so doubling R halves I.
items.explainAf: I = V ÷ R, dus halveer I wanneer R verdubbel.

items.q: Two 3 Ω resistors are connected in series. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Twee 3 Ω-weerstande is in serie gekoppel. Wat is die totale weerstand?
items.explainAf: In serie tel weerstande op: 3 + 3 = 6 Ω.

items.q: Two 6 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Twee 6 Ω-weerstande is in parallel gekoppel. Wat is die totale weerstand?

items.q: In a series circuit, one bulb burns out (breaks the circuit). What happens to the others?
items.qAf: In ’n serie-stroombaan brand een gloeilamp uit (breek die stroombaan). Wat gebeur met die ander?
items.explain: In a series circuit there is only one path, so a break stops the current through every bulb.
items.explainAf: In ’n serie-stroombaan is daar net een pad, dus stop ’n onderbreking die stroom deur elke gloeilamp.

items.q: The rate of flow of charge.
items.qAf: Die tempo van vloei van lading.

items.q: The work done per unit charge to move charge between two points.
items.qAf: Die arbeid verrig per eenheid lading om lading tussen twee punte te beweeg.

items.q: The voltage across the terminals of a battery when no current flows.
items.qAf: Die spanning oor die pole van ’n battery wanneer geen stroom vloei nie.

items.q: The direction in which positive charge would flow, from + to − outside the cell.
items.qAf: Die rigting waarin positiewe lading sou vloei, van + na − buite die sel.

items.text: Current is measured in [[]], and charge equals current multiplied by [[]].
items.textAf: Stroom word in [[]] gemeet, en lading is gelyk aan stroom maal [[]].

items.q: Resistors in parallel share the same potential difference.
items.qAf: Resistors in parallel deel dieselfde potensiaalverskil.
items.explain: True. Each branch is connected across the same two points.
items.explainAf: Waar. Elke tak is oor dieselfde twee punte verbind.

items.q: A charge of 30 C passes a point in 1 minute. Calculate the current.
items.qAf: ’n Lading van 30 C beweeg in 1 minuut verby ’n punt. Bereken die stroom.

items.q: Resistors of 4 Ω and 12 Ω are connected in parallel. Calculate the equivalent resistance.
items.qAf: Resistors van 4 Ω en 12 Ω word in parallel verbind. Bereken die ekwivalente weerstand.

items.q: A 12 V battery transfers 240 J of energy. How much charge passed through it?
items.qAf: ’n 12 V-battery dra 240 J energie oor. Hoeveel lading het daardeur beweeg?
